missingValuePolicy: Missing counts, shares, years, and rank values remain explicit; countries without a source-backed record have no map wordmark.
boundaryPolicy: A community-compiled source-listed observation, not a unified official global surname ranking or a census comparison.
coverageNote: Source-listed records are community observations, not a unified global ranking. The African supplement provides one article-listed observation per listed country and does not establish rank. Fixed manual observations are country-specific, unranked, and kept separate from numeric sources. Non-sovereign anchors without a country-specific source remain empty and are not assigned a borrowed or synthesized surname.
